Maria G.: quick async update — what I did / blockers / today
Maria G.: DID: landed qos token-bucket adapter for kernel scheduler (basic rate shaping across microbatch slots)
Maria G.: BLOCKER: seeing odd prefetch+evict interaction on 1k seq traces — hot-prefixes still getting evicted under load, want eyes on eviction heuristics
Maria G.: TODAY: iterate on eviction threshold logic, add a small reproducer, and run 2x KV benches against canary build
Kai C.: nice — can you drop the reproducer here when you have it? i can try a few header/prefix combos from chat workloads
Ben W.: pinging on the PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/1284 — I added a feature flag `kernel.qos.enabled` + metric hooks
Ben W.: also added metric: `kv.eviction.score` so we can plot what triggered evict
Maria G.: thx @Ben W., i'll wire the metric into the bench harness. probably want a short-lived canary to validate on dedi pool
Ryan T.: quick note — on dedi pool yesterday we saw slot-starvation when qos bursts hit same GPU, could be related to token-bucket release timing
Ryan T.: suggests we might want to jitter release intervals or add per-slot backoff counters
Kai C.: +1 on jitter, add an exponential backoff up to 50ms seems safe. also can we gate the prefetch size by current kv.hit_rate? small adaptive prefetch might avoid churn
Maria G.: plan: add adaptive prefetch cap = min(prefetch_max, floor(kv.hit_rate * prefetch_max)) as a feature flag behind `kernel.prefetch.adaptive`
Maria G.: repro steps i'll share: 
```
# reproducer (rough)
./tools/run_local_repro --model redwood-7b --seq 1024 --concurrency 8 --prefetch 32 --trace out.json
# then run bench parser to show evict events
python tools/parse_evictions.py out.json
```
Ben W.: putting a short smoke test in CI: `tests/smoke/qos_prefetch_smoke.py` — if it flakes we'll gate behind slow-ci
ops-bot: deploy: canary/runtime-qos-2026-03-17 started on pool-dedicated-2 :rocket:
Ryan T.: @Maria G. when you run the KV bench can you include `--warmup 120` to let the slot queues stabilize? otherwise evictions spike from cold starts
Maria G.: good call. i'll run bench with warmup and collect `kv.eviction.score`, `kv.hit_rate`, and `kernel.slot_util`
Kai C.: if you can paste the perf graphs after run i'll look at correlations. :eyes:
Ben W.: code review note on PR: prefer `u64` for the token bucket counters to avoid wrap on long uptimes, left inline comment
Maria G.: addressed comment and force-pushed; running bench now on canary id c-2301-qos-prefetch
Maria G.: initial bench: 10% lower p99 latency, but evict rate increased ~1.6x when concurrency >= 16 — investigating
Ryan T.: could be the backpressure not propagating fast enough; maybe throttle prefetch when slot_util > 0.85
Maria G.: adding a soft cap: if slot_util > 0.85 reduce prefetch by 50% for 10s window
Kai C.: sounds reasonable. small follow-up: add a metric `kernel.prefetch.throttled` to see how often we hit that window
Maria G.: will add. thanks team — i'll post final bench graphs + canary link here when available
Ben W.: acked, will review the smoke test and metrics dashboards after you post
Maria G.: thanks — leaving this thread open for any quick Qs, will ping again once canary finishes
_post_process_notes: file generated as a single-threaded slack conversation; messages are short and include code snippets, links, and bot deploy message.
